title: Aemon Gremm
description: Aemon Gremm was the faithful Hylobon in service of Dryden Vos and Crimson Dawn, personally tasked as the Captain of Vos's security forces. Insisting all security decisions were funneled through him, he was an intimidating task master with a violent past. Despite his experience at security, he was still fooled by Han Solo's ruse on Savareen and it cost him and his master everything.
